body:
## Summary

Phase 2 of the wyrd-ami pipeline, second of two split PRs (after PR #96).

- **Phase 2a (PR #96, merged):** schema columns + ingest plumbing.
- **Phase 2b (this PR):** `english_shaped` derivation rules + CLI backfill.

Adds `wyrd/generators/kenning/english_shaping.py` with `derive_english_shaped()` plus `wyrd kenning lexicon derive-english-shaped --apply` to populate the column. 48,070 etymon rows already populated against the live lexicon; the column is now available for downstream consumers (generator integration + SPA panel — separate PRs).

## Priority order

1. **`KNOWN_FORM_OVERRIDES`** — ~70 hardcoded cultural / literary forms (rakshasa, jinn, golem, ifrit, marid, shaitan, naga, garuda, yaksha, tiamat, ghoul, simurgh, peri, behemoth, leviathan, lilith, cherub, seraph, ...). Match is case-insensitive on the pre-strip transliteration. Overrides win over rule output.
2. **Rule-based diacritic stripping** of the transliteration, two passes:
   - Digraphs (multi-char output): `ṯ→th, ḫ→kh, ǧ→j, š→sh, ġ→gh, ḏ→dh, ś/ṣ→sh, ñ→ny, ṅ→ng, ʒ→zh, θ→th, χ→kh, ŋ→ng`
   - Single-char: emphatics (`ḍ/ḥ/ṭ/ẓ/ḳ→base`), retroflex (`ṛ/ṇ/ḷ→base`), long vowels (`ā/ī/ū/ē/ō→base`), stress-acute (`á/é/í/ó/ú→base`), Hebrew rafe (`ḇ→v`), Arabic ḥā (`ħ→h`), IPA vowels (`ɪ/ʊ/ɛ/ɔ/ɐ/ə`), silenced glottals (`ʿ/ʾ/ʔ/ʕ → ''`).
   - Final `_looks_english_readable` check rejects outputs that still carry non-ASCII residuals — better NULL than half-stripped.
3. **IPA fallback** when transliteration is missing. Same pipeline applied to the IPA string after stripping `/[]/`, length marks, stress marks, and tie-bars. Coarser than (2).

Returns `None` when the source language is in `_LATIN_SCRIPT_LANGS` (`canonical_form` is already English-readable for `old-english`, `old-french`, `latin`, `welsh`, `proto-germanic`, ...). The CLI's SQL filter narrows to the wave-2 non-Latin set so we don't sweep millions of rows that wouldn't yield anything.

## Empirical first-pass coverage

Live `~/.wyrd/lexicon.db`:

| language     | written | total non-Latin rows | rate |
|--------------|--------:|---------------------:|-----:|
| fa Persian   |  13,777 |               20,242 |  68% |
| he Hebrew    |  12,889 |               15,220 |  85% |
| ar Arabic    |  11,548 |               64,698 |  18% |
| sa Sanskrit  |   5,028 |               12,523 |  40% |
| egy Egyptian |   2,618 |                4,343 |  60% |
| arc Aramaic  |   1,245 |                2,696 |  46% |
| akk Akkadian |     965 |                1,614 |  60% |
| **TOTAL**    |  **48,070** |                  |      |

Skipped 85,034 rows where both transliteration and IPA were missing or unstrippable. Arabic is the lowest hit rate because most Arabic wiktextract entries lack `tr` in head_templates; future work could LLM-fill those.

## Verified samples

| canonical | transliteration | english_shaped | path |
|-----------|-----------------|----------------|------|
| גרוד | `gōlem` | `golem` | override |
| راغرپا | `ʿifrīt` | `ifrit` | override |
| راعرذ | `rākṣasá` | `rakshasa` | override |
| गरूण | `garuḍá` | `garuda` | rule (`ḍ→d`, `á→a`) |
| שָטָן | (no translit) | `satan` | IPA fallback |
| گلچه | `golče` | `golche` | rule (`č→ch`) |
| שבת | `l'vaním` | `lvanim` | rule (`'` silenced, `í→i`) |

## CLI

```
wyrd kenning lexicon derive-english-shaped --apply
```

Flags:
- `--language <code>`: filter to one language for incremental smoke runs
- `--limit N`: cap the row count for sampling
- `--reshape`: re-derive non-NULL rows (after editing the override table or the rule maps); default leaves existing values alone.

Idempotent — re-running on the same DB produces identical output.

## Test plan

- [x] 38 new tests in `tests/test_kenning_english_shaping.py` covering both primitive functions (`_apply_digraphs`, `_apply_single_chars`, `_strip_transliteration`, `_looks_english_readable`, `_ipa_to_english_fallback`) and the top-level `derive_english_shaped`.
- [x] Priority order (override > rule > IPA) pinned via `test_derive_known_form_override_wins_over_rule_strip`.
- [x] Case-insensitive override match (`test_derive_known_form_override_case_insensitive`).
- [x] Latin-script-language skip (`test_derive_skips_latin_script_languages`).
- [x] Per-language parametrized canonical-creature smoke covering 18 (transliteration, expected) pairs across all 7 wave-2 non-Latin languages.
- [x] 721 tests passing across `test_kenning_english_shaping.py`, `test_kenning_lexicon.py`, `test_kenning_wiktextract_ingester.py`, `test_kenning_fantasy_pipeline.py`.
- [x] Full backfill executed against `~/.wyrd/lexicon.db` (48,070 rows written).
- [x] `ruff format` + `ruff check` clean.
- [ ] PR review loop on push.

## Out of scope (Phase 2c+ / follow-ups)

- **Generator integration** — town-name generation should pick `english_shaped` over `canonical_form` for non-Latin source langs. Separate PR.
- **SPA etymological-provenance panel** — render all four renderings (original_script / transliteration / english_shaped / IPA). Separate PR.
- **LLM backfill for the 85,034 skipped rows** — those rows have no transliteration / IPA in wiktextract; only an LLM could derive english_shaped from canonical_form alone. Deferred until empirical demand surfaces.
- **Canonical-rollup view for `cluster_ocr_variants` merges** — when a richer row gets merged into a canonical that lacks the new columns, the canonical view should pull `english_shaped` from the loser. Phase 2c.

Module: wyrd/generators/kenning/english_shaping.py

derive_english_shaped(canonical_form, language, transliteration,
pronunciation_ipa) -> str | None walks three priority paths:

  1. KNOWN_FORM_OVERRIDES — ~70 hardcoded cultural / literary forms

  2. Rule-based diacritic stripping. Two passes:
     - Digraphs (multi-char output): ṯ→th, ḫ→kh, ǧ→j, š→sh, ġ→gh,
       ḏ→dh, ś/ṣ→sh, ñ→ny, ṅ→ng, ʒ→zh, θ→th, χ→kh, ŋ→ng
     - Single-char: emphatics (ḍ/ḥ/ṭ/ẓ/ḳ→base), retroflex (ṛ/ṇ/ḷ→base),
       long vowels (ā/ī/ū/ē/ō→base), stress-acute (á/é/í/ó/ú→base),
       Hebrew rafe (ḇ→v), Arabic ḥā (ħ→h), IPA vowels (ɪ/ʊ/ɛ/ɔ/ɐ/ə),
       silenced glottals (ʿ/ʾ/ʔ/ʕ → ''), IPA strip
     A final _looks_english_readable() check rejects outputs that still
     carry non-ASCII residuals — better NULL than half-stripped.
  3. IPA fallback when transliteration is missing. Same digraph +
     single-char pipeline applied to the IPA string after stripping
     /[]/, length marks, stress marks, and tie-bars. Coarser than (2).

Returns NULL when the source language is in _LATIN_SCRIPT_LANGS
(canonical_form is already English-readable for old-english,
old-french, latin, welsh, proto-germanic, etc.).

CLI: wyrd kenning lexicon derive-english-shaped --apply

Walks every wave-2 non-Latin etymon row whose english_shaped is NULL
and UPDATEs it with the derivation result. Flags:
  --language <code>  filter to one language
  --limit N          smoke / sample
  --reshape          re-derive non-NULL rows (after editing rules)

Empirical first-pass coverage on ~/.wyrd/lexicon.db:
  | language     | written | total non-Latin rows |
  |--------------|--------:|---------------------:|
  | fa Persian   |  13,777 |               20,242 |
  | he Hebrew    |  12,889 |               15,220 |

Verified samples:
  גרוד (gōlem) → 'golem'    [override]
  راغرپا (ʿifrīt) → 'ifrit' [override]
  راعرذ (rākṣasá) → 'rakshasa'  [override]

  שָטָן (no translit) → 'satan'  [IPA fallback]
  گلچه (golče) → 'golche'    [rule: č→ch via digraph]
  שבת (l'vaním) → 'lvanim'   [rule: ' silenced, í→i]

Tests: +38 in tests/test_kenning_english_shaping.py covering both
extractor primitives, the priority order (override > rule > IPA),
case-insensitive override match, Latin-script-skip, NULL-input
return, and per-language canonical-creature parametrization. 721

Out of scope (Phase 2c+):
